label: Spain, international tourist arrivals
question: Which country had the most international arrivals in 2024?
answer: Spain recorded 93.8 million international arrivals in 2024, up 10.09%. It is the highest 2024 figure in this dataset, but not the world's highest: UN Tourism ranks France first at roughly 102 million, and France has no 2024 entry in the series used here.
sample: UN Tourism international tourist arrivals, via Our World in Data. France has no 2024 entry in this series
methodology: UN Tourism international tourist arrivals, accessed via Our World in Data, 2024. Arrivals count trips, not people: one traveller making three trips counts three times. France is absent from the 2024 cut of this dataset, so any 'most-visited' ranking derived from it alone is incomplete.
